set.body:
Plan: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: F03
Accountable role (person not assigned): Backend engineer

Outcome: Every repository access path reflects current organizational authority, with explainable effective access.

Acceptance:
- Replace permanent curator bypass with governed stewardship and enforce principal disablement, membership removal and grant expiry transactionally.
- Apply authority to directory listings/counts, dataset/release reads, queries, preparations, acceptance/retries/receipts, downloads and run input/destination use; preserve bounded disclosure and fixed-release semantics.
- Add authorized effective-access inspection and negative fixtures for cross-lab leakage, independent grants, concurrent policy changes and stale contexts; ensure continuing delivery rechecks the declared policy bound.

Evidence anchors:
- modules/kernel/src/main/scala/sanctity/kernel/Authority.scala
- modules/postgres/src/main/scala/sanctity/postgres/PostgresCatalog.scala
- modules/integration/src/test/scala/sanctity/postgres/HttpSuite.scala

Status: planned; no implementation or qualification claimed.
set.title: F03: Enforce current memberships, principal state and expiring access
